A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the older '''sister''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]],<ref name="Characters" /> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] by [[62 BBY/Legends|62 BBY]]<ref name="Birthdate" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Panaka's sister was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], an organization that Panaka also joined.<ref name="Characters" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> Panaka's sister was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Naboo during a live-fire exercise. Panaka was offworld when it happened, and he coped with his grief by dedicating himself to his work, which later made it difficult for him to form friendships.<ref name="Characters" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quarsh Panaka's sister was mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Characters" />
